'''Zaree Lolvanci''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] reporter for the [[Kuati First Holo-News]]. She tried to interview [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] after he took the witness stand in fellow Rogue [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu's]] [[Trial of Tycho Celchu|trial]].<ref name="X-Wing: The Krytos Trap" />
